propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json off disk and uses field values for drift classification, so narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade classification accuracy
bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of the working tree file that is not exercised by reconcile_once tests, making field-dependence issues undetectable by standard unit tests
field-based drift classification must report indeterminate rather than inferring from empty dicts when field values are genuinely required but absent
against key-set prev fixtures, bridge_fsck drift classification must be identical to full-payload fixtures for membership-only cases and report indeterminate for field-dependent cases
against full-payload prev, bridge_fsck behavior must remain byte-identical with no regression
rebar bridge-fsck exit code and JSON shape must remain unchanged for both key-set and full-payload fixtures
